answer: For a poll on a crystal ornament hung by a thread from a juniper, a contract locks a refundable $10 deposit for 30 days per ballot. The server checks finalized deposits bound to ballot hashes, accepts each deposit once, and rejects invalid or reused deposits. Extra votes tie up $10 each for 30 days; borrowed funds may incur interest. Wealthy attackers can still vote many times, and locking funds excludes some voters.
